world.title: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC finds

world.description: Officials say they both travelled through Entebbe International Airport on 3 October.

US.title: Europe's heat claims 50,000 lives. Climate change blamed for two-thirds of deaths

US.title: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates
US.description: The Iguazú Falls span more than a mile across both countries. A rain-soaked October, which scientists link to the Super El Niño, has sent near-record volumes of water surging over the towering cliffs.

US.title: A GOP congressman voted to cut Medicaid. It covers 62% of his district. Can he win?
US.description: Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is fighting for reelection in central California. 6 in 10 residents of his district are covered by Medicaid, which he voted to cut last year.

US.title: Trump's redistricting gave Republicans a head start, now it goes to the voters

US.title: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
